Nishmat Yeladim — reshut No2 from the Old Sefaradi Tiqun for Shabbat Shim'u, by Yaaqov haPayyetan of Castile

tei:div.tei:head: Nishmat Yeladim — reshut No2 from the Old Sefaradi Tiqun for Shabbat Shim'u, by Yaaqov haPayyetan of Castile

tei:lg.tei:l: The soul of jettisoned children at Ariel’s ruin,
shamed and disgraced that they did not hear the words of the Deity —
hear the Cause’s word, house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel! (Jeremiah 2:4)
The soul of astonished paupers from the day my shadows fled
will witness You; righteous speech he told them, “Hear my words, children:
What fault did your fathers find in Me that they from Me?” (Jeremiah 2:5)
The soul of consecrated ones sleeping between the oven and stove go mounfully,
for they abandoned the religion of the Heavenly Dweller;
they did not say, “Where is the Cause who brought us up from the land of Egypt?” (Jeremiah 2:6)
The soul of observant ones in poverty, darkened in their captive place,
will exalt You, raising their voice in pleas in the sound of oceans and their tumult,
saying “Were our mouths as full of song as the sea...”

tei:note.tei:p: The Temple, or Jerusalem as a whole
A midrashic reading of Song of Songs 2:17 as Divine presence being taken away
Find Taanit 30b, where it states that R. Yehuda bar Ilai would stay in this uncomfortably hot space during the night before the Ninth of Av.
From the prayer, Nishmat Kol Ḥai
